A mother cursed God, and He folded His hands and said, I accept. Stay till the end, His answer will stay with you.
As the story goes, after the great war, Gandhari had lost all hundred sons. Blindfolded and broken, she told Krishna, you could have stopped this. But then she said what no one expected.
Your family will fall, just like mine. Your golden city will sink into the sea. Wait, what did Krishna do?

He didn't get angry. He bowed and said, Mother, I accept. That's why Krishna is called the ocean of compassion. He doesn't run from our pain. He sits with it. Comment Karuna, and send this to someone hurting today.
